full_judgment: Bijan Kumar Das, J: This First Miscellaneous Appeal is directed against the judgment and order dated 7-9-1987 passed by the District Judge, Dhaka in Miscellaneous Case No. 59 of 1986 under section 35(3) of the Wakfs Ordinance setting aside those dated 21-2-1986 passed by the Waqf Administrator in Enrolment Case No. 1579 directing the Waqf Administrator to dispose of the said EC No. 15719 after the disposal of Title Suit No. 27 of 1974 pending in the Court of the Subordinate Judge, Dhaka. One Alhaj Md Hossain Khan filed an application under section 50 of the Waqf Ordinance, 1962 being Diary No. 5184 dated 17-10-1984 praying for cancellation of the enrolment made in the said EC No. 15719 in respect of Alhaj Md Yusuf Sarder Waqf Estate on the allegation that the petitioner and another filed Title Suit No. 27 of 1974 for declaration of title and recovery of possession of the schedule properties including other properties against the aforesaid Alhaj Md Yusuf Sarder (now deceased) who was the sole defendant in the said suit. It is alleged that during tendency of the suit the defendant Alhaj Md Yusuf Sarder created waqf of the suit property by a declaration dated 1-7-1976 and constituted himself as the first mutwalli of Yusuf Sarder Waqf Estate. It is stated in the application for cancellation of the enrolment that the property mentioned therein appertaining to Mouza Dhanmondi, Khatian No. 26 and plot Nos. 692-694 and 696 measuring 0.24 katha 2 chhatak belonged to the petitioner and his co-sharers and their uncle Alhaj Md Yusuf Sarder had no interest in the said property but he fraudulently created a waqf in respect of the said property and got it enrolled in EC No. 15719. It is stated that no notice for enrolment of the suit property as waqf property was served on the co-sharers and they prayed for cancellation of the enrolment of the property as waqf property.
